# Erdos.p28 — Erdős problem 28

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/28
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/28.lean`, theorem `erdos_28`, AMS 11).

If $A ⊆ \mathbb{N}$ is such that $A + A$ contains all but finitely many integers then
 $\limsup 1_A ∗ 1_A(n) = \infty$.

## Statement
∀ (A : Set ℕ) (h : (A + A)ᶜ.Finite), limsup (fun (n : ℕ) => (sumRep A n : ℕ∞)) atTop = (⊤ : ℕ∞)

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
